I found your order, Shop····. It's paid and your Magic M. 40T hasn't shipped yet.

I'm sorry about the wait. We gave dates on the 40T that we didn't keep, and we haven't kept you updated the way we should have. Production paused to fix a problem with the control board. That's now fixed and the final version is approved. Magic M. expects the units to ship out from the factory on November 12, which is today.

We'll email tracking to (email hidden) as soon as your miner ships to you.
